useCases: Tasks: projects with custom workflows, list, board and timeline views, sub-issues, labels, saved views, trash, and GitHub sync.
Docs: page tree with live collaborative editing, version history, search, and Notion import.
Chat: channels, direct messages, threads, files, and search.
readmeSummary: A self-hosted workspace for teams: tasks, docs, chat, and mail in one app on your own server.
